        "contents": "    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceKeyBannerView: View {\n    let message: String\n    let onSetKey: () -&gt; Void\n    let onDismiss: () -&gt; Void\n\n    var body: some View {\n        HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 12) {\n            Image(systemName: \"exclamationmark.triangle.fill\")\n                .foregroundColor(.yellow)\n                .font(.title3)\n\n            Text(message)\n                .font(.footnote)\n                .foregroundColor(.white)\n                .lineLimit(3)\n\n            Button(action: onSetKey) {\n                Image(systemName: \"key.card\")\n                    .foregroundColor(.black)\n                    .font(.title3)\n                    .padding(6)\n            }\n            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)\n            .tint(.white)\n            .accessibilityLabel(Text(\"device_key_banner_set_button\"))\n\n            Button(action: onDismiss) {\n                Image(systemName: \"xmark.circle.fill\")\n                    .foregroundColor(.white.opacity(0.9))\n            }\n            .buttonStyle(PlainButtonStyle())\n            .accessibilityLabel(Text(\"device_key_banner_dismiss\"))\n        }\n        .padding(12)\n        .background(\n            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14)\n                .fill(Color.black.opacity(0.85))\n        )\n        .padding(.horizontal, 12)\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    iPhone_RootView()\n}",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2026, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * iPhone_6_OnboardingDeviceKeyView.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 31.01.26.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct iPhone_6_OnboardingDeviceKeyView: View {\n    var onFinish: () -&gt; Void = {}\n    @State private var showDeviceKeySheet = false\n\n    var body: some View {\n        VStack(spacing: 32) {\n            Spacer()\n            Text(\"device_key_title\")\n                .font(.largeTitle)\n                .fontWeight(.bold)\n            Image(\"devicekey\")\n                .resizable()\n                .scaledToFit()\n                .frame(width: 300)\n                .padding(.horizontal)\n                .accessibilityHidden(true)\n            Text(\"device_key_intro_text\")\n                .font(.body)\n                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)\n                .padding(.horizontal)\n            Button(\"device_key_banner_set_button\") {\n                showDeviceKeySheet = true\n            }\n            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)\n            .tint(.blue)\n            .accessibilityHint(Text(\"device_key_button_hint\"))\n            .padding(.horizontal)\n            .sheet(isPresented: $showDeviceKeySheet) {\n                iPhone_DeviceKeySheetView(showsMismatchWarning: false)\n            }\n            Spacer()\n        }\n        .padding()\n        .background(Color(.systemBackground))\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    iPhone_6_OnboardingDeviceKeyView()\n}",

        "contents": "            .sheet(isPresented: $showCustomKeySheet) {\n                DeviceKeyEntrySheet(\n                    titleKey: \"device_key_custom_title\",\n                    messageKey: \"device_key_custom_message\",\n                    confirmKey: \"device_key_custom_confirm\",\n                    initialValue: settings.deviceKey ?? \"\",\n                    showsRegenerateButton: true,\n                    onRegenerate: {\n                        await regenerateDeviceKey()\n                    }\n                ) { enteredKey in\n                    await setCustomDeviceKey(enteredKey)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private var deviceKeyUnsetContent: some View {\n        VStack(spacing: 16) {\n            Image(systemName: \"key.card\")\n                .font(.system(size: 104))\n                .foregroundColor(keyCardColor)\n                .padding(.top, 8)\n                .frame(width: 140, height: 140, alignment: .center)\n                .contentShape(Rectangle())\n                .onLongPressGesture {\n                    showCustomKeySheet = true\n                }\n\n            if showsMismatchWarning {\n                Text(\"device_key_mismatch_explanation\")\n                    .font(.footnote)\n                    .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)\n                    .padding(.horizontal, 16)\n            }\n\n            Text(\"device_key_intro_text\")\n                .font(.body)\n                .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)\n                .padding(.horizontal, 16)\n\n            Button {\n                Task { await generateAndSetDeviceKey() }\n            } label: {\n                if isBusy {\n                    ProgressView()\n                } else {\n                    Text(\"device_key_generate_button\")\n                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)\n                }\n            }\n            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)\n            .tint(.blue)\n            .disabled(isBusy)\n            .padding(.horizontal, 16)\n        }",

updates\n\n**Test Files:**\n\n- &#96;miataruTests/MutualNavigationDetectorTests.swift&#96;\n- &#96;miataruTests/VisitorHistoryViewModelTests.swift&#96;\n\n## Localization - Required Strings\n\n**MANDATORY**: All strings below must be added to &#96;miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings&#96; with translations for all 10 supported languages (en, de, da, es, fi, fr, it, ja, nl, zh-Hans).\n\n### String Keys and English Source Values\n\n1. **Mutual Navigation**:\n\n   - &#96;\"mutual_navigation_active\"&#96; = \"mutual active\" (comment: \"Indicates that both devices are actively navigating to each other\")\n   - Example usage: &#96;NSLocalizedString(\"mutual_navigation_active\", comment: \"Indicates that both devices are actively navigating to each other\")&#96;\n\n2. **Visitor History**:\n\n   - &#96;\"visitor_history_title\"&#96; = \"Visitor History\" (comment: \"Title for visitor history screen\")\n   - &#96;\"visitor_history_empty\"&#96; = \"No Access\" (comment: \"Empty state message when no visitors have accessed the device\")\n   - &#96;\"visitor_history_error\"&#96; = \"Failed to load visitor history\" (comment: \"Error message when visitor history fails to load\")\n   - &#96;\"visitor_history_retry\"&#96; = \"Retry\" (comment: \"Button to retry loading visitor history\")\n\n3. **Device Labels**:\n\n   - &#96;\"unknown_device_label\"&#96; = \"Unknown Device\" (comment: \"Label for unknown/unrecognized device\")\n   - &#96;\"add_device_action\"&#96; = \"Add\" (comment: \"Button label to add an unknown device\")\n\n4. **Time Formatting**:\n\n   - &#96;\"time_ago_minutes\"&#96; = \"%d min ago\" (comment: \"Time ago format for minutes, e.g., '5 min ago'\")\n   - &#96;\"time_ago_hours\"&#96; = \"%d hr ago\" (comment: \"Time ago format for hours, e.g., '2 hr ago'\")\n   - &#96;\"time_ago_days\"&#96; = \"%d days ago\" (comment: \"Time ago format for days, e.g., '3 days ago'\")\n   - &#96;\"time_just_now\"&#96; = \"Just now\" (comment: \"Indicates very recent time, within the last minute\")\n\n5. **Accessibility**:\n\n   - &#96;\"visitor_history_accessibility_label\"&#96; = \"Visitor History\" (comment: \"Accessibility label for visitor history button\")",

        "contents": "- Create a new SwiftUI sheet view (new file under &#96;views/iPhone/&#96; or &#96;views/Common/&#96;) that supports two states:\n  - **State A (no key set):**\n    - Explanation text (English) describing the purpose and irreversibility (cannot remove, only change), and risk if lost.\n    - “Generate and set DeviceKey” button that:\n      - Generates a UUID string.\n      - Calls &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setDeviceKey&#96; with &#96;currentDeviceKey: nil&#96;.\n      - On success: persist key + timestamp in &#96;SettingsManager&#96; and transition to State B.\n      - On failure: show server error message and keep State A.\n  - **State B (key set):**\n    - Text field (read-only style) that shows the key and a copy icon, following the existing clipboard pattern in &#96;iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView&#96;.\n    - Long-press gesture on the displayed key that opens a custom key entry form:\n      - Allows the user to enter a custom DeviceKey (up to 256 Unicode chars).\n      - Calls &#96;setDeviceKey&#96; with current + user-provided key on submit.\n      - On success: persist key + timestamp; on error: show server message and keep form open with entered value.\n    - Date/time display (formatted from &#96;deviceKeyLastChanged&#96;).\n    - “Regenerate/Reset” button:\n      - Generates UUID, calls &#96;setDeviceKey&#96; with current + new key, and updates persistence on success.\n    - “Restore” button:\n      - Opens an input dialog (custom sheet or alert-style with text entry).\n      - Calls &#96;setDeviceKey&#96; with user-provided key for both &#96;currentDeviceKey&#96; and &#96;newDeviceKey&#96; to validate.\n      - On error: show server message and reopen with previous text.\n- Keep all user-facing strings in English and add new localization keys in the app’s &#96;.strings&#96; files if that is the current pattern for UI text.\n\nSheet presentation pattern reference:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;116:133:/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView.swift\n                .sheet(isPresented: $showMailComposer, onDismiss: { qrImage = nil }) {\n                    ",

        "contents": "          }\n        }\n      }\n    },\n    \"device_key_intro_text\" : {\n      \"comment\" : \"Explanation for device key setup\",\n      \"localizations\" : {\n        \"da\" : {\n          \"stringUnit\" : {\n            \"state\" : \"translated\",\n            \"value\" : \"En DeviceKey beskytter positionsopdateringer, besøgsoversigt og adgangskontrolindstillinger.\\n\\nNår den er sat, kan nøglen ikke fjernes - kun ændres. Opbevar den sikkert og gem en kopi et trygt sted.\\n\\nDet er valgfrit at sætte den, men det gør din brug mere sikker.\"\n          }\n        },\n        \"de\" : {\n          \"stringUnit\" : {\n            \"state\" : \"translated\",\n            \"value\" : \"Ein DeviceKey schützt Standortaktualisierungen, Besucherhistorie und Zugriffssteuerungseinstellungen.\\n\\nSobald er gesetzt ist, kann der Schlüssel nicht entfernt werden - nur geändert. Bewahre ihn sicher auf und speichere eine Kopie an einem sicheren Ort.\\n\\nDas Einrichten ist optional, macht deine Nutzung aber sicherer.\"\n          }\n        },\n        \"en\" : {\n          \"stringUnit\" : {\n            \"state\" : \"translated\",\n            \"value\" : \"A DeviceKey protects location updates, visitor history, and access control settings.\\n\\nOnce set, the key cannot be removed - only changed. Keep it safe and store a copy in a secure place.\\n\\nSetting it is optional but makes your use more secure.\"\n          }\n        },\n        \"es\" : {\n          \"stringUnit\" : {\n            \"state\" : \"translated\",\n            \"value\" : \"Un DeviceKey protege las actualizaciones de ubicación, el historial de visitantes y la configuración de control de acceso.\\n\\nUna vez establecido, la clave no se puede eliminar - solo cambiar. Guárdala de forma segura y guarda una copia en un lugar seguro.\\n\\nConfigurarlo es opcional, pero hace tu uso más seguro.\"\n          }\n        },\n        \"fi\" : {\n          \"stringUnit\" : {\n            \"state\" : \"translated\",",

\"\")\n                        .font(.system(.caption, design: .monospaced))\n                        .padding(.horizontal, 12)\n                        .padding(.vertical, 8)\n                        .background(Color(.systemGray6))\n                        .cornerRadius(8)\n                        .lineLimit(1)\n                        .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)\n\n                    Button(action: copyDeviceKey) {\n                        Image(systemName: \"doc.on.doc\")\n                            .foregroundColor(.blue)\n                    }\n                    .buttonStyle(PlainButtonStyle())\n                    .accessibilityLabel(Text(\"device_key_copy_label\"))\n                    .accessibilityHint(Text(\"device_key_copy_hint\"))\n                }\n            }\n            .padding(.horizontal, 16)\n\n            if let lastChangedText = formattedLastChanged() {\n                Text(String(format: NSLocalizedString(\"device_key_last_changed\", comment: \"\"), lastChangedText))\n                    ",

        "contents": "    }\n\n    @Published var deviceKey: String? {\n        didSet {\n            if let key = deviceKey, !key.isEmpty {\n                defaults.set(key, forKey: Keys.deviceKey)\n            } else {\n                defaults.removeObject(forKey: Keys.deviceKey)\n            }\n            if deviceKeyAuthBlocked,\n               let blockedKey = deviceKeyAuthBlockedKey,\n               let currentKey = deviceKey,\n               !currentKey.isEmpty,\n               blockedKey != currentKey {\n                deviceKeyAuthBlocked = false\n                deviceKeyAuthBlockedKey = nil\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    @Published var deviceKeyLastChanged: Date?         "contents": "---\nname: devicekey_auth_flow\noverview: Add DeviceKey persistence, management UI, and authenticated requests across protected operations, plus consistent error handling that routes users to the DeviceKey sheet when auth fails.\ntodos:\n  - id: store-devicekey\n    content: Add DeviceKey + timestamp to SettingsManager\n    status: completed\n  - id: devicekey-sheet\n    content: Build DeviceKey sheet UI and flows (A/B states)\n    status: completed\n  - id: wire-devicekey\n    content: Pass DeviceKey into protected API calls\n    status: completed\n  - id: auth-error-handling\n    content: Force sheet on auth errors + user feedback\n    status: completed\n  - id: strings-tests\n    content: Add strings and validate with tests/manual checks\n    status: completed\nisProject: false\n---\n\n# DeviceKey Authentication Plan\n\n## Scope And Entry Points\n\n- Persist current DeviceKey and last-change timestamp in &#96;SettingsManager&#96; with:\n  - &#96;@Published var deviceKey: String?&#96; stored under a new key, and remove the value when nil.",

SwiftUI\n\nstruct iPhone_RootView: View {\n    @ObservedObject private var settings = SettingsManager.shared\n    @State private var selectedTab = 0\n    @State private var showDeviceKeySheet = false\n    @State private var showDeviceKeyBanner = false\n    @State private var deviceKeyBannerMessage = \"\"\n    @State private var deviceKeySheetShowsMismatch = false\n\n    var body: some View {\n        TabView(selection: $selectedTab) {\n            iPhone_DevicesView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"devices\", systemImage: \"iphone.gen3.badge.location\")\n                }\n                .tag(0)\n            iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"qr\", systemImage: \"qrcode\")\n                }\n                .tag(1)\n            iPhone_SettingsView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"settings\", systemImage: \"gear\")\n                }\n                .tag(2)\n        }\n        .environmentObject(DeviceGroupStore.shared)\n        .environmentObject(RouteInfoState.shared)\n        .environmentObject(SettingsManager.shared)\n        .bottomAccessory(onTap: nil)\n        .adaptiveToolbarBackground()\n        .sheet(isPresented: $showDeviceKeySheet) {\n            iPhone_DeviceKeySheetView(showsMismatchWarning: deviceKeySheetShowsMismatch)\n        }\n        .onAppear {\n            if settings.deviceKeyAuthBlocked {\n                deviceKeyBannerMessage = NSLocalizedString(\"device_key_auth_mismatch_message\", comment: \"Message when stored DeviceKey does not match server\")\n                withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.25)) {\n                    showDeviceKeyBanner = true\n                }\n                deviceKeySheetShowsMismatch = true\n                showDeviceKeySheet = true\n            }\n        }\n        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: .deviceKeyAuthRequired)) { notification in\n            deviceKeyBannerMessage = (notification.userInfo?[\"message\"] as? String)\n                ",

        "contents": "- For the specific protected calls, wrap errors and, on auth failure:\n  - Show a short error message (alert/banner) explaining the key is missing/invalid.\n  - Automatically present the DeviceKey sheet (per your preference).\n  - Do not auto-retry; user retries manually after updating the key.\n\n## UI And Flow Diagram\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\nparticipant User\nparticipant QRView\nparticipant DeviceKeySheet\nparticipant Settings\nparticipant API\n\nUser-&gt;&gt;QRView: Tap key.card\nQRView-&gt;&gt;DeviceKeySheet: Present\nalt NoDeviceKey\n    DeviceKeySheet-&gt;&gt;API: setDeviceKey(nil,newUUID)\n    API--&gt;&gt;DeviceKeySheet: success\n    DeviceKeySheet-&gt;&gt;Settings: store key + timestamp\nelse HasDeviceKey\n    DeviceKeySheet-&gt;&gt;API: setDeviceKey(current,newUUID)\n    API--&gt;&gt;DeviceKeySheet: success\n    DeviceKeySheet-&gt;&gt;Settings: update key + timestamp\n    opt Restore\n        User-&gt;&gt;DeviceKeySheet: Enter previous key\n        DeviceKeySheet-&gt;&gt;API: setDeviceKey(key,key)\n        API--&gt;&gt;DeviceKeySheet: success or error\n    end\n    opt CustomKeyLongPress\n        User-&gt;&gt;DeviceKeySheet: Long-press key, enter custom key\n        DeviceKeySheet-&gt;&gt;API: setDeviceKey(current,custom)\n        API--&gt;&gt;DeviceKeySheet: success or error\n    end\nend\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n\n## Tests And Validation\n\n- Add unit tests (if test targets are used for view models) for:\n  - &#96;SettingsManager&#96; DeviceKey persistence behavior.\n  - Validation flow for restore (success and server error) if the logic is abstracted into a view model.\n- Manual test checklist:\n  - Fresh install: “Generate and set DeviceKey” succeeds and persists.\n  - App relaunch: key + timestamp restored from UserDefaults.\n  - Update location succeeds with key; invalid key yields error and forces sheet.\n  - Visitor history requests pass key and behave correctly on auth failure.\n  - Regenerate and restore flows update storage and UI states.\n\n## Files Likely Touched\n\n- &#96;[/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/SettingsManager.swift](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/SettingsManagers/App%20Settings/SettingsManager.swift)&#96;\n- &#96;[/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView.swift](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView.swift)&#96;",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * thisDeviceIDManager.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\n\nclass thisDeviceIDManager {\n    static let shared = thisDeviceIDManager()\n    private let legacyFileName = \"deviceID.plist\"\n    private let modernFileName = \"deviceIDmodern.txt\"\n    \n    private var cachedDeviceID: String? = nil\n    \n    private init() {}\n    \n    /// Gibt die gespeicherte oder neu generierte deviceID zurück\n    var deviceID: String {\n        if let cached = cachedDeviceID {\n            return cached\n        }\n        // Safely attempt to load the persisted ID; fall back to generating\n        // and storing a new one if loading fails for any reason.\n        guard let loaded = loadDeviceID() else {\n            // Fallback: create a fresh ID to avoid crashes on startup\n            let newID = UUID().uuidString\n            saveDeviceID(newID)\n            cachedDeviceID = newID\n            return newID\n        }\n        cachedDeviceID = loaded\n        return loaded\n    }\n\n    private var appDirectory: URL? {\n        guard let appSupportDir = try? FileManager.default.url(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask, appropriateFor: nil, create: true),\n              let bundleID = Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier else {\n            return nil\n        }\n        return appSupportDir.appendingPathComponent(bundleID)\n    }\n    \n    private var legacyFileURL: URL? {\n        return appDirectory?.appendingPathComponent(legacyFileName)\n    }\n    \n    private var modernFileURL: URL? {\n        return appDirectory?.appendingPathComponent(modernFileName)\n    }\n    \n    private func ensureAppDirectoryExists() {\n        guard let dir = appDirectory else { return }\n        if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: dir.path) {\n            try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: dir, withIntermediateDirectories: true, attributes: nil)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func saveDeviceID(_ id: String) {\n        debugLog(\"[DEBUG] Attempting to save deviceID: \\(id)\")",

        "contents": "---\nname: devicekey_usage_audit\noverview: Add DeviceKey support to Miataru client location endpoints and wire it through all location/history call sites so navigation and history use the device key when configured.\ntodos:\n  - id: client-devicekey-payloads\n    content: Add deviceKey to getLocation/getLocationHistory payloads + APIs\n    status: pending\n  - id: wire-call-sites\n    content: Pass deviceKey in all getLocation/getLocationHistory calls\n    status: pending\n  - id: verify-coverage\n    content: Search for remaining call sites and update\n    status: pending\nisProject: false\n---\n\n## Scope\n\n- Update Miataru client payloads and APIs to accept optional &#96;DeviceKey&#96; for location and history requests.\n- Propagate &#96;settings.deviceKey&#96; into all call sites for &#96;getLocation&#96; and &#96;getLocationHistory&#96; across iPhone/iPad device and group views.\n- Keep encoding behavior consistent with existing optional DeviceKey handling patterns.\n\n## Key findings\n\n- &#96;getLocation&#96; ## Changes Made:

1. **Added new localization key** `device_key_banner_configure_button` in `Localizable.xcstrings` with translations for all supported languages:
   - English: "Configure DeviceKey"
   - Danish: "Konfigurer DeviceKey"
   - German: "DeviceKey konfigurieren"
   - Spanish: "Configurar DeviceKey"
   - Finnish: "Määritä DeviceKey"
   - French: "Configurer le DeviceKey"
   - Italian: "Configura DeviceKey"
   - Japanese: "DeviceKey を設定"
   - Dutch: "DeviceKey configureren"
   - Chinese (Simplified): "配置 DeviceKey"

2. **Updated the view** (`iPhone_6_OnboardingDeviceKeyView.swift`):
   - Added `@StateObject private var settings = SettingsManager.shared` to access the device key state
   - Added a computed property `hasDeviceKey` to check if the device key is set
   - Changed the button text to conditionally show `"device_key_banner_configure_button"` when the device key is set, otherwise `"device_key_banner_set_button"`
   - Changed the button tint to `.green` when the device key is set, otherwise `.blue`

The button now shows "Configure DeviceKey" (or the translated equivalent) with a green tint when the device key is already set, and "Set DeviceKey" with a blue tint when it's not set.
